FULTON COUNTY SHERIFF’S OFFICE

AUGUST 4, 2026, SHERIFF’S LEVY SALE

DELINQUENT TAX LIENS AND JUDICIAL FORECLOSURE

SALE LIST

THE BID AMOUNT MUST BE PAID BY CASHIER’S OR CERTIFIED CHECK MADE PAYABLE TO
FULTON COUNTY SHERIFF’S OFFICE, FOR THE EXACT AMOUNT. PAYMENTS ARE ACCEPTED AT
THE SHERIFF’S OFFICE PAYMENT SERVICES WINDOW (J1-G500) LOCATED ON THE GROUND
FLOOR INSIDE THE JUSTICE CENTER TOWER AT 185 SHIRLEY CLARKE FRANKLIN BLVD., SW,
(FORMERLY KNOWN AS CENTRAL AVE SW), ATLANTA, GA 30303.

O.C.G.A. 9-13-170: ANY PERSON WHO BECOMES THE PURCHASER OF ANY REAL OR PERSONAL
PROPERTY AT ANY SALE MADE AT PUBLIC OUTCRY WHO FAILS OR REFUSES TO COMPLY WITH
THE TERMS OF THE SALE WHEN REQUESTED TO DO SO, SHALL BE LIABLE FOR THE AMOUNT
OF THE PURCHASE MONEY.

IN THE EVENT THAT ANY BIDDER REFUSES TO COMPLY WITH HIS/ HER BID OR FAILS TO TENDER
THE REQUIRED PAYMENT BY 3:00 P.M. ON THE DAY OF THE SALE, WILL FORFEIT THE
OPPORTUNITY TO BID IN ANY SUCCEEDING AUCTIONS AND SUBJECT YOU TO THE PROVISIONS
AND REMEDIES OFFERED THROUGH O.C.G.A 9-13-170.

THIS LIST IS NOT FINAL AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE PRIOR TO THE SHERIFF’S LEVY SALE
SCHEDULED FOR TUESDAY, AUGUST 4, 2026.
